answer: An operator must lock a 5,000 token reputation escrow that any validator can slash the moment two clones behave identically or share a wallet, so sybil farms are priced out before they start. Spinning up 2,000 fake agents means posting 40,000 in bonds and burning 30 days of setup while earning nothing, and one failed rendezvous at the summit erases their whole rating.
